method: Complete three pinned documentation reads and Git/SHA256 verification; cross-check against already audited source. Commands and external links treated as reference text only.
findings: Install dependency section requires GLib>=2.74 and json-glib, consistent with SConstruct; later sentence says only GLib is hard requirement, contradicting required json-glib probe. No missing-package build executed.

GUI page says GTK>=3.14 while install page says>=3.22. Pyproject Python>=3.12 and other package dependencies were audited separately; GUI minimal dependency prose is not an exhaustive install specification.

GUI editor documentation promises editing generated script; previously audited on_run_script_clicked does not transfer text buffer edits to script file. Documentation therefore cannot qualify applied-edit behavior.
Deleted-byte counter is described as deleted storage, but previously reviewed RunningLabel sums stat sizes from output lines, without operation confirmation or physical-storage accounting.
GUI recheck promise is bounded by actual forced paranoid script options and filesystem races; it is not proof that every result or action succeeded. No destructive operation performed.
README speed and most-Unix compatibility assertions are scope claims, not measurements or platform gates. Pinned workflows and current local no-default test report are separate evidence.
Install examples use moving develop branch and distribution package inventories; no current availability/version claims made and no system package commands executed.
Homebrew GUI omission is a pinned documentation statement, not checked current packaging fact. Container mount example exposes selected directory only, distinct from host filesystem completeness.
Referenced screenshots, external badges and embedded video remain unviewed in this audit and receive no visual-review credit. GPLv3 reference-only decision remains.
limits: No package installation, GUI runtime, visual inspection or performance qualification.
